intent: To establish the millennial demographic as a mature generation of adults transitioning from education to the workforce and career paths.

requirements.question: Should the clip explicitly bound millennials as 20-24 through 40-44, or is one boundary sufficient?

units.claim: The millennial cohort spans from the youngest age band 20-24 to the oldest age band 40-44.
accept: Millennials range from the 20-24 age band through the 40-44 age band.
The youngest millennials are in the 20-24 group and the oldest are in the 40-44 group.
The millennial span shown covers 20-24 to 40-44.
